summary: v48c-rev6 Blob-fetch PDF download/view fix fully verified on /register. Both buttons are <button type='button'> (not <a>). Download triggers Playwright download event, suggested filename='pmc-registration-form.pdf', PDF header %PDF- present, size=4435 bytes, pypdf parses 2 pages. Toast 'Downloading blank form…' shows in sonner. Busy states 'Downloading…' / 'Opening…' with disabled=true observed and revert to 'Download blank form' / 'View' after completion. View button calls window.open with a blob:https://... URL (captured via window.open monkey-patch since Chrome's built-in PDF viewer swallows popup.url as expected). Option E toggle regression: body[data-ui='e'] set with ?ui=e, cleared with ?ui=default. Admin package-card regression could not be exercised (0 pkg-card-view-* elements found on /admin?tab=packages after admin login — likely a routing/hydration mismatch in headless mode; iteration_33 already validated this regression 100%).
critical_code_review_comments: RegistrationStart.jsx fetchTemplateBlob correctly caches created blob URLs in revokeRef and revokes them on unmount — good memory hygiene.
Popup-blocked fallback (window.location.href = url) is present but not exercised in headless Chrome; acceptable given browser variance.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The Blob-based PDF download flow on /register works end-to-end in Playwright. Note: to verify popup View, monkey-patch window.open to capture URL (popup.url returns ':' because Chrome PDF viewer replaces the document). Admin packages regression should be validated in a UI where the admin dashboard fully renders pkg-card-view-* — in this test iteration those cards didn't appear after login redirect.
